traits.name: Minion
traits.description: The shellmite's attacks can't critically hit, and they're immediately defeated when they suffer an injury.

traits.name: Rugged Camouflage
traits.description: An undetected shellmite gains an advantage on attack tests. While the shellmite is motionless, they're almost indistinguishable from a normal rock, requiring a successful DC 14 Survival test to identify them. This test gains a disadvantage when the shellmite is in cover or in an area where the other character's primary sense is obscured.

actions.name: Feeding Frenzy
actions.description: Costs 2 Focus. The shellmite whips up a frenzy against an enemy within 5 feet of them. Each shellmite within 5 feet of the target can use their reaction to join the frenzy. The target takes 2 (1d4) keen damage per frenzied shellmite.

strikes.name: Pincer
strikes.description: Attack +2, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 2 (1d4) keen damage. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) keen damage.
